--------------------------------------------------------------------------
WELCOME - THIS IS THE SLOW LANE

Hello, and thank you for signing up. This newsletter does one job: it
explains the AI tools in your life in plain English, step by step, without
making you feel behind.

Every issue has three parts: a few short stories, one link worth your
time, and an unsubscribe link at the very bottom that works in one click.
No tricks, no homework.

You will never need prior experience. If something can be explained like a
friend would, that is how it gets explained here.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------
START WITH ONE SMALL TASK, NOT A BIG PROJECT

Most people quit with AI in week one for a boring reason: they pick a goal
the size of a monument. Rewrite my whole resume. Automate my entire inbox.
Instead, pick something that takes five minutes and holds no risk.

Good first tasks: draft a grocery list around a budget, rewrite one
confusing email into a friendly one, or summarize an article you saved
last month but never finished.

The win is not the task. The win is learning the rhythm of asking,
reading, and fixing - which is the same rhythm for everything bigger
later.

Link (The Massive AI Manual - the book this digest grew out of):
  https://dylanasdale.github.io/

--------------------------------------------------------------------------
ONE THING WORTH YOUR TIME

Pick one five-minute task tonight and let any AI assistant try it. If the
answer is wrong, that is a normal result, not a personal failure - just
tell it what to fix.

  https://dylanasdale.github.io/
